📄 Capability Statement

AMT Imaging Solutions LLC

Certified SDVOSB & VOSB | MRI • CT • Contrast Injector Service

Precision. Performance. Trust.

Company Overview

AMT Imaging Solutions LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) specializing in third-party maintenance and service for MRI, CT, and contrast injector systems. We provide high-quality, cost-effective Labor-Only and Preventive Maintenance (PM) services with fast response times and competitive pricing.

Core Services:
  • Labor-Only Repair & Troubleshooting (MRI, CT, Injectors)
  • Preventive Maintenance (PM) Contracts
  • Magnet Ramping & Shimming (1.5T & 3T)
  • Emergency / On-Site Service Support
  • Injector PM and Repair
Key Differentiators:
  • SDVOSB & VOSB Certified (SBA) – Veteran-Owned (USMC)
  • 25+ years field service experience
  • Significantly lower rates than OEM service
  • Flexible Labor-Only & PM-Only contract options
  • Fast response and reliable support
Geographic Coverage:
🏭 Primary: Florida & Houston, Texas
✈️ Willing to travel for service as needed
